create_backend_options: create backend options for declarative, HTML, markdown, PDF, Excel, LaTeX, or XBRL document processing
build_html_backend_options: build HTML backend options with headless browser rendering, page dimensions, and image fetching settings
create_pdf_backend_options: create PDF backend options with optional password protection for encrypted documents
build_excel_backend_options: build Excel backend options with gap tolerance, singleton cell handling, and selective sheet names
create_backend_options_discriminated_uni: create a discriminated union type that selects the correct backend options class by kind field
